objective: Gather engagement by asking whether viewers notice ingredients or brand stance first before purchase, while staying visually tied to the April 8 trust feed.
source_strategy: Generate two separate Nano Banana story plates: an object-led or hands-led trust opener with protected upper-left copy space, then a softer editorial plate with a centered sticker-safe zone for the native poll.
fallback_source: Fallback to a text-led body frame only if the frame 2 generated plate breaks the middle sticker-safe zone.
visual_intent: lighter and faster than the April 8 feed
no fake UI and no execution scaffolding
brand_guardrails: preserve top and bottom safe zones
do not generate fake poll UI
do not render sticker placement notes or internal posting instructions on-canvas
keep frame 2 visually open enough for the native poll sticker
protect the opener text zone against the image focal area
keep typography weight and spacing locked across both frames
do not add on-canvas wording beyond the creative package copy lock
composition: frame 1 uses a calm Nano Banana trust-oriented editorial plate with an object-led or hands-led lifestyle moment and a protected upper-left text zone
frame 2 uses a softer editorial background with a dedicated centered poll-safe panel zone, headline and support copy above it, and one compact route-back note below it
keep frame 2 cleaner than the April 8 story and avoid repeating the option labels on-canvas
